task_description: Perform an exhaustive manual QA audit of the Budget Tracker web app (Next.js 16 / React 19 / Supabase / Gemini) that lives on origin/feature/budget-tracker (commit d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b), and produce a full QA report (QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md) covering all 9 deliverable sections: QA Summary, Bug Report Table, Detailed Bug Reports, UX Suggestions, Security Findings, Accessibility Findings, Performance Findings, Production Readiness Score (0-100), and Final Recommendation. Live-test everything runnable without external credentials; code-review everything gated behind missing Supabase/Gemini keys and mark it Blocked (not passed/failed). main is only a stock create-next-app starter, so the feature branch is the real audit target.
